title: ho mubarakbinte shaahe karbala paida hui
body:
ho mubarak binte shaahe karbala paida hui
duqtare shabbir jaane fatima paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne rakkha hai sakina naam is moulood ka
noore chashme qamise aale aba paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
momino me har taraf shore mubarak baad hai
shahe waala lo wo chashme ziya paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khushi ka roz ye aur hai masarrat ki ghadi
qasime naar o jina'n ki dilruba paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bohat masroor shaadaa'n ab shahide karbala
sab ke sab khush hai ke sheh ki mailaqa paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
zainabe zeejaah deti hai mubarak baad ab
kehti hai bhai mubarak dilruba paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate kulsoom bhi kehti hai ab ye shaah se
bhaijaa'n tumko mubarak mailaqa paida hui
